## Not covered: no safe automatic fix

<a id="sa1118"></a>

### SA1118: Parameter should not span multiple lines

**Why:** A multi-line argument (other than the first, or a lambda/anonymous object) needs extracting into a variable: a refactoring that names things.

**To revisit:** Only if a deterministic extraction is acceptable (variable name from the parameter name). Probably stays a human job.

<a id="sa1317"></a>

### SA1317: Identifier should be named only with Latin letters

**Why:** A name with a non-Latin letter (`ЕxаmplеClаss`, `café`) needs a new name a person chooses; transliterating is a guess.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1401"></a>

### SA1401: Fields should be private

**Why:** Making a public or protected field private changes the public API and breaks callers.

**To revisit:** Only for private nested types or `internal` fields without InternalsVisibleTo, converting to a property. Probably not worth it.

<a id="sa1402"></a>

### SA1402: File may only contain a single type

**Why:** Moving a type to its own file isn't something `dotnet format` can do (code fixes can't add documents through it).

**To revisit:** Would need a separate tool (bro could do it as a one-off).

<a id="sa1403"></a>

### SA1403: File may only contain a single namespace

**Why:** Splitting namespaces into files has the same problem as SA1402.

**To revisit:** Same as SA1402.

<a id="sa1404"></a>

### SA1404: Code analysis suppression should have justification

**Why:** The justification of a SuppressMessage has to be written by a person.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1405"></a>

### SA1405: Debug.Assert should provide message text

**Why:** The message for Debug.Assert has to be written by a person.

**To revisit:** A generated message (the condition's text, like CallerArgumentExpression) is possible but adds little.

<a id="sa1406"></a>

### SA1406: Debug.Fail should provide message text

**Why:** The message for Debug.Fail has to be written by a person.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1414"></a>

### SA1414: Tuple types in signatures should have element names

**Why:** Tuple element names in signatures have to be chosen by a person.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1601"></a>

### SA1601: Partial elements should be documented

**Why:** Missing documentation on a partial element; the only fix is placeholder text (no stubs, user decision).

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision.

<a id="sa1602"></a>

### SA1602: Enumeration items should be documented

**Why:** Missing documentation on enum members; the only fix is placeholder text (no stubs, user decision).

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision.

<a id="sa1603"></a>

### SA1603: Documentation should contain valid XML

**Why:** Invalid XML needs a person to say what was meant.

**To revisit:** A narrow fix is possible: escape a lone `&` or `<` in text. Probe how often that's the cause.

<a id="sa1604"></a>

### SA1604: Element documentation should have summary

**Why:** A doc comment without `<summary>`; the fix would be placeholder text.

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision. If the comment has plain text outside any tag, wrapping it in `<summary>` is a real fix: worth a probe.

<a id="sa1605"></a>

### SA1605: Partial element documentation should have summary

**Why:** Same as SA1604 for partial elements.

**To revisit:** With SA1604.

<a id="sa1606"></a>

**Why:** An empty `<summary>`; the fix would be placeholder text (no stubs, user decision).

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision.

<a id="sa1607"></a>

### SA1607: Partial element documentation should have summary text

**Why:** Same as SA1606 for partial elements.

**To revisit:** With SA1606.

<a id="sa1608"></a>

### SA1608: Element documentation should not have default summary

**Why:** The default "Summary description for X" text has to be replaced by a person.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1609"></a>

### SA1609: Property documentation should have value

**Why:** Missing `<value>`; the fix would be placeholder text (no stubs, user decision).

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision. A `<value>` derived from the summary ("Gets the name." -> "The name.") is conceivable.

### SA1610: Property documentation should have value text

**Why:** An empty `<value>`; the fix would be placeholder text.

**To revisit:** Removing the empty tag would be a real fix, but trades one diagnostic for SA1609. Decide with SA1609.

<a id="sa1639"></a>

### SA1639: File header should have summary

**Why:** The header's `<summary>` has to be written by a person.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1645"></a>

### SA1645: Included documentation file does not exist

**Why:** A missing `<include>` file can't be fixed automatically.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1646"></a>

### SA1646: Included documentation XPath does not exist

**Why:** A wrong `<include>` XPath can't be fixed automatically.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1647"></a>

### SA1647: Include node does not contain valid file and path

**Why:** An `<include>` without file/path can't be fixed automatically.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic.

<a id="sa1648"></a>

### SA1648: inheritdoc should be used with inheriting class

**Why:** `<inheritdoc/>` where there is nothing to inherit: the fix is real documentation.

**To revisit:** Nothing automatic. (BRO1601 only adds `<inheritdoc/>` where there is something to inherit.)

<a id="sa1649"></a>

### SA1649: File name should match first type name

**Why:** Renaming files isn't something `dotnet format` can do.

**To revisit:** Would need a separate tool (bro could do it as a one-off, with `git mv`).

<a id="sa1653"></a>

### SA1653: Only one partial declaration should contain summary documentation

**Why:** Which part of a partial type keeps the `<summary>` is a person's choice; a fix that picks the declaration it is applied to gives a result that depends on which diagnostic comes first.

**To revisit:** Only with a deterministic choice (for example the declaration in the file named after the type).

## Not applicable

<a id="sa0001"></a>

### SA0001: XML comment analysis disabled

**Why:** A setup diagnostic, not a code rule: XML comment analysis is disabled (no GenerateDocumentationFile).

**To revisit:** Nothing to port. bro migrate already detects the same condition and keeps the XML documentation rules (BRO1603-BRO1611) off.

<a id="sa0002"></a>

### SA0002: Invalid settings file

**Why:** A setup diagnostic, not a code rule: stylecop.json is invalid.

**To revisit:** Nothing to port. bro migrate parses stylecop.json leniently (comments, trailing commas).

## Partly covered

<a id="sa1206"></a>

### SA1206: Declaration keywords should follow order

**Covered by:** SDK: IDE0036 (`csharp_preferred_modifier_order`), which checks the whole modifier order

**Scope:** IDE0036 (`csharp_preferred_modifier_order`) enforces the whole modifier order, not only the access modifier first and `static` next, so it can also reorder modifiers such as `async override`.

**To revisit:** Only if a team reports reorders it wants to keep (`async override` vs `override async`); then a BRO rule that only moves access modifiers and `static`.

<a id="sa1600"></a>

### SA1600: Elements should be documented

**Covered by:** [BRO1601](rules/BRO1601.md), for overrides and implementations (`<inheritdoc/>`); other missing documentation isn't covered

**Scope:** BRO1601 adds `<inheritdoc/>` to overrides and implementations; other missing documentation isn't reported (no stubs, user decision).

**To revisit:** Revisit with the stub decision (also SA1601, SA1602, SA1604-SA1607, SA1609-SA1611, SA1614-SA1616, SA1618, SA1619, SA1622).
